On Wednesday, April 8, 2026, the Social Security Administration (SSA) issues payments to beneficiaries born between the 1st and 10th of any month. This is the first major wave of April payments, following the April 3rd payments for those who received benefits before May 1997 or receive SSI. Key Details for April 8 Payments: Who is paid: Those with birthdates from the 1st–10th. When: Second Wednesday of the month. Average Payment: Approx. $1,928 for retired workers. Remaining April 2026 Payment Schedule: April 15 (Third Wednesday): Birthdays on the 11th–20th. April 22 (Fourth Wednesday): Birthdays on the 21st–31st. If your payment does not arrive on time, the SSA recommends waiting three additional mailing days before contacting them. For more information, you can check your SSA account online.
